datasheet_identity.title: NCE P-Channel Enhancement Mode Power MOSFET

extraction_notes: The datasheet title block says P-Channel Enhancement Mode Power MOSFET; all electrical limits and characteristic labels use negative p-channel signs.

P-channel threshold, resistance, breakdown, and current values are retained as positive magnitudes because the mosfet archetype requires p-channel fitting in magnitudes; polarity is recorded separately as p.
The electrical characteristics table gives VGS(th) min -1.0 V, typ -1.9 V, max -3.0 V at VDS = VGS and ID = -250 uA; all three min/typ/max meanings are preserved as magnitudes.
The electrical table gives RDS(ON) typ 73 mOhm and max 85 mOhm at VGS = -10 V and ID = -5 A; both values are retained as separate schema points.
The p. 3 output curve, p. 4 transfer/Rdson/capacitance/body-diode curves were manually digitized from the published typical figures. Points are curve readings, not interpolated vendor or SPICE data.
No body-diode reverse-recovery time is published. Switching delay, rise/fall times, and gate charge are transcribed in the source but are not represented by this extraction schema.
RthetaJA is 62.5 degC/W maximum on FR4 with t <= 10 sec; thermal resistance is not represented by this extraction schema.
omission_reason: No body-diode reverse-recovery time is published. Gate charge, switching times, thermal resistance, IGSS, IDSS, and power/current ratings are present in the PDF but have no fields in the strict extraction schema.
